title: The hat on a hook
logline: A hat on a hook by the tavern's door. The 2007 regular's. He's gone; the hat isn't. The page draws it the way the strip drew the chair, the lamp, the coat: as the person.

panels.composition: A wooden hook by a tavern door with a worn felt hat on it, the brim shaped by one head over decades, dust on the crown. Below it, on the floor, nothing. The door's light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a worn felt hat hanging on a wooden hook beside a tavern door with dust on its crown and the brim shaped by long wear, light from the door, no people, no words
image.notes: Dale's hat (dw_2007-10-10, dw_2007-10-19). Gully knew the name; the page still doesn't say it.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
